findings.ai_classification: Software Integration & Rule-Based Orchestration (Zero Novel Algorithmic AI)

adaptive_engine.py.actual_implementation: First-order Exponential Moving Average (EMA): M_t = M_{t-1} + alpha * (S - M_{t-1})
adaptive_engine.py.scientific_verdict: Terminology inflation. No Bayesian inference, no Hidden Markov Model, no latent state parameter estimation (P(L0), P(T), P(G), P(S)).

ml_analyzer.py.actual_implementation: Rule-based peak-count thresholding within fixed delta-lambda windows. The defined 'cosine_similarity' function is dead code (never called).
ml_analyzer.py.scientific_verdict: Terminology inflation. No machine learning models, no trained weights, no vector embeddings, no supervised or unsupervised clustering.

lab_agent.py.actual_implementation: Declarative tool schemas (12 tools) formatted for commercial LLM function calling (Gemini / OpenAI API)
lab_agent.py.scientific_verdict: Standard tool-calling software wrapper. While useful as an educational interface, it does not represent an independent AI research contribution.

ai/router.py.actual_implementation: HTTP proxy with fallback failover across commercial LLMs (Groq, Gemini, OpenRouter, OpenAI)

findings.recommendation_for_manuscript: STRIP ALL UNSUPPORTED AI CLAIMS. Frame SimuPharm as a 'mechanistic computational simulation platform' rather than an 'AI system'. Any paper attempting to claim novel AI will be mercilessly rejected by reviewers.
